articles.summary: Archer and Formula 1 announced a multi-year partnership for Archer to be at select Grands Prix events that align with key commercial markets they plan to operate in across the US, Middle East, Asia and Europe. The partners plan to explore the future integration of eVTOL air taxi services at Grand Prix events with the goal of flying VIPs and fans to and from Grand Prix circuits in minutes aboard Midnight. ( Watch Video ) Today, Archer (NYSE: ACHR) and Formula 1 announced a multi-year partnership for Archer to be at select Grands Prix events that align with key commercial markets the company plans to operate in across the US, Middle East, Asia and Europe. Additionally, the partners plan to explore the future integration of eVTOL air taxi services at Grand Prix events with the goal of flying VIPs and fans to and from Grand Prix circuits in minutes aboard Midnight. articles.summary: Received Midnight’s Market Survey Special Airworthiness Certificate from the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) unlocking operations in Los Angeles in coming weeks as Archer prepares for carrying passengers as part of Department of Transportation’s eVTOL Integration Pilot Program (eIPP) and LA28 Games. Acquisition of Boeing’s Wisk, Insitu, and SkyGrid businesses nearing close, set to accelerate Archer’s evolution into becoming a diversified aerospace and defense platform with significant revenue generating operations 1 . Began testing the turboshaft engine for Archer’s Halo/Thunder hybrid, autonomous VTOL platform and remain on-track to begin full-scale flight testing next year with Anduril. Archer partners with Formula 1 on a multi-year relationship to explore the future integration of eVTOL air taxi services at Grand Prix events.
